whenToUse: People choose a nearby date for a visit, booking, or delivery.
The day of the week matters.
You need to show dates that can't be chosen (past days, holidays).
whenNotToUse: Distant dates such as a birthday (use a date input).
A few options such as today or tomorrow are enough (use quick date chips).
People choose a period (use a date range picker).

alternatives.name: Date Range Picker
alternatives.reason: Choosing a start and end date together.

accessibility: The button opens the calendar with aria-haspopup="dialog", and focus returns to it on close.
The calendar is role="grid": the arrows move by a day or a week, and Page Up/Down by a month.
Date button names are full dates such as "Wed, November 25", and today has aria-current="date".
Unavailable days are announced with aria-disabled, and Esc closes the calendar.
